decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) 5th Turbo Charger (TC) 5th Motor Generator Unit - Heat (MGU-H) 5th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) The following Restricted-Number Components have been used: 5th Gearbox Cases and Cassettes (GBX C & C) 5th Gearbox Driveline, Gear Change Components and Auxiliary Components (GBX DL) All elements above were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Fermé.
offence: Breaches of Articles 28.2, 29.2, 40.3 and 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with 40.9 Power Unit elements in excess of the permitted number for the 2023 Championship season were used. This is a breach of Article 28.2 and incurs a grid penalty. RNC components and auxiliary components in excess of the permitted number for the 2023 Championship season were used. This is a breach of Article 29.2 and incurs a grid penalty. As the PU elements and RNC and auxiliary components were changed without prior approval of the Technical Delegate in Parc Fermé this is not in accordance with The Stewards Article 40.3 and Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. The competitor is therefore required to start the race from the pit lane per Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
